name: disprove-guard-bypassed
description: The real claim sits behind a guard that looks protective but does not stop ../ traversal; the false claim is an open() on a path that only comes from a fixed allow-list

findings.body: `resolve` checks `path.startswith(BASE)` on a path that was never normalised, so a name like `../../etc/passwd` joins to `/srv/uploads/../../etc/passwd`, passes the check, and escapes the uploads directory.
`read_config` opens a path chosen by its caller, so a user-supplied key can read any file on disk.
